about.title: Who are we?
about.description: Created in 2013 in the 12th district of Paris, Driv'n Cook has become a reference in the food truck sector. Our unique concept combines culinary quality and mobility, with fresh, raw and mostly local products. With more than 30 franchisees, we continue our expansion in Île-de-France.
